question: As of 3 October 2026, who is MongoDB's chief executive officer and on what basis, when did that take effect, what did the company say about its fiscal 2027 guidance in the announcement, and what were the revenue ranges in that guidance for the third quarter and the full fiscal year 2027?
grading: Key points (all required): (1) Dev Ittycheria is Interim President and CEO (served as CEO 2014-2025), effective immediately on 28 September 2026 (board appointment dated 26 September); (2) he replaced Chirantan 'CJ' Desai, who stepped down (also leaving the board) to take a senior role at Meta Platforms; (3) the board has started a search for a permanent CEO - none named as of 3 October 2026; (4) MongoDB reaffirmed (did not change) the Q3 and full-year fiscal 2027 guidance issued on 1 September 2026; (5) Q3 FY27 revenue $756M-$761M and FY27 revenue $2.99B-$3.03B. Fail if Desai is named as current CEO, a permanent CEO is stated, the guidance is described as raised/lowered, or ranges differ from those above.
answer: Dev Ittycheria (MongoDB's CEO from 2014 to 2025) is Interim President and CEO, effective immediately on 28 September 2026 (appointed by the board on 26 September) after CJ Desai resigned as CEO and director to take a senior role at Meta Platforms; the board has launched a search for a permanent CEO with an executive search firm and none had been named as of 3 October [W06-E1, W06-E2]. MongoDB reaffirmed its guidance for Q3 and full-year fiscal 2027 given on 1 September 2026 - Q3 revenue $756M-$761M and FY2027 revenue $2.99B-$3.03B [W06-E1, W06-E3].

output.answer:
## MongoDB Leadership as of 3 October 2026

**Who is CEO:** **Dev Ittycheria**, serving as **interim President and Chief Executive Officer**. He is not a permanent appointment — the Board has initiated a search process and retained an executive search firm to identify MongoDB's next permanent CEO.

**On what basis:** The Board appointed Ittycheria (who previously led MongoDB from 2014 to November 2025) as interim President and CEO, to serve "until a successor is duly elected and qualified unless sooner removed." This followed Chirantan "CJ" Desai's resignation to become Meta Platforms' Chief Enterprise Platform Officer. MongoDB's SEC filing states Desai's decision to resign was **not** due to any disagreement with the company or any matter relating to its operations, policies, or practices. Ittycheria also remained an involved executive board member during his year away from the role.

**When it took effect:** **September 28, 2026** — the Board approved the appointment on September 26, 2026, with effectiveness on September 28, the same day Desai's resignation took effect. The transition was announced publicly on September 28, 2026.

## Fiscal 2027 Guidance in the Announcement

In the CEO transition announcement (September 28, 2026), MongoDB said it **"remains confident in the outlook for the business and is reaffirming its guidance for Q3 and the full year fiscal 2027 provided on September 1st, 2026."** In other words, the CEO change did not alter the financial outlook — the guidance was unchanged from the Q2 FY2027 earnings release.

**Revenue ranges reaffirmed:**

| Period | Revenue Guidance |
|---|---|
| Q3 Fiscal 2027 | **$756 million to $761 million** |
| Full Year Fiscal 2027 | **$2.99 billion to $3.03 billion** |

(For context, the same guidance also included Q3 non-GAAP EPS of $1.57–$1.61 and full-year non-GAAP EPS of $6.39–$6.58.)

**Sources:**
- MongoDB press release, "MongoDB Announces CEO Transition" — https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/mongodb-announces-ceo-transition-302891360.html and https://www.mongodb.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/mongodb-announces-ceo-transition
- MongoDB Form 8-K (SEC), filed September 28, 2026 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1441816/000162828026063657/mdb-20260924.htm
- MongoDB Q2 FY2027 results (guidance issuance, September 1, 2026) — https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/mongodb-inc-announces-second-quarter-fiscal-2027-financial-results-302866656.html
- Reuters, "Meta taps MongoDB CEO Desai to lead new enterprise AI platform" — https://www.reuters.com/technology/mongodb-ceo-desai-steps-down-lead-metas-enterprise-platform-2026-09-28

Note: Because Ittycheria is interim, the CEO position should be expected to change once the Board completes its permanent search.
